environment.description: Provider binary executes within an OCI container where the root filesystem overlay is mounted with MS_RDONLY flag at the runtime level (runc spec). The container spec sets 'rootfs.readonly: true' in the OCI runtime bundle config.json. No additional tmpfs, emptyDir, or volume mounts are attached to the container — the only writable layer available would be the overlay upperdir, which is inaccessible due to the read-only rootfs propagation. The container uses runc 1.1.9 with the default seccomp profile (which permits open/openat/write syscalls — filesystem calls are NOT blocked by seccomp). Note: the provider process CAN call os.Create() and os.MkdirAll() without seccomp interference; the EROFS/EACCES error surfaces only at the VFS layer when the kernel enforces the read-only mount namespace property.
